rca_of_issue: Bug reported: (a) reader schermata drifted horizontally during edge swipes and (b) swipe-back within ~1.5s of opening dismissed the return overlay prematurely. RCA: (a) previous swipe-back had translation on the wrapped view — new implementation removes ALL translation and only fires an intent when the finger crosses TRIGGER=56 (or release ≥32 / velocity >600); (b) the OPEN morph scheduled a 2500ms safetyDismiss on the morph-host to guarantee the overlay clears if the reader never mounts, but it was NOT cancelled on unmount, so when the user swiped back within ~2s the timer fired on the RETURN morph and hid it after ~500ms. Fix: `useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(safetyDismiss.current), [])` in story-morph.tsx. Both fixes verified: reader-x=0 across 24+ drag samples; return morph host duration ≥800ms in every tested path (left, right, immediate, center-drag no-op, chapter-close, 3x consecutive).
